dct_description_sm: Abstract: World Wildlife Fund Ecoregions represent 24,944 defined global ecoregions. Ecoregions are defined as relatively large areas of land or water that share a large majority of their species, dynamics, and environmental conditions.
Purpose: Dataset was developed for use by GIS software in global or continental scale applications.
